svg.title: How AgentBuff is built
svg.desc: People: Business owner, Admin. Platform: AgentBuff portal, Identity provider. Per user: Isolated container, PostgreSQL. Outside: Chat channels, AI provider, Partner apps. One container and one data volume per user, with capped memory, CPU and processes, on a VPS with backups.
svg.text: The main parts and how data moves between them.
One container and one data volume per user, with capped memory, CPU and processes, on a VPS with backups.
